$comment: Areas of the engine API reference (scripts/build-api.mjs). Every top-level .odin file of the engine (not _test.odin) must be listed in exactly one area: the build fails on unmapped or doubly mapped files. order: the sidebar order (the index page is 0); label: the sidebar label when it differs from the title.

areas.title: Core: application, game, scenes and nodes
areas.label: Core
areas.description: The application and its frame loop, the game and its scenes, nodes and their transforms, events, timers and the package's memory model.

areas.title: Rendering
areas.description: Drawing shapes and textures in a node's space, render targets, texture atlases, tile batches and the choice of renderer.

areas.title: Text and fonts
areas.description: Drawing and measuring text, bitmap and MSDF fonts, and localization.

areas.title: Camera
areas.description: The Camera2D node, follow modes and pans, parallax layers, camera zones, smooth zoom and camera views.

areas.title: Input
areas.description: Keyboard, mouse and gamepad state, input actions, and rebinding.

areas.title: Physics
areas.description: The Box2D world, physics nodes and joints, contact and area events, queries, materials, collision traced from images and debug drawing.

areas.title: Audio
areas.description: SDL_mixer setup, sound and music nodes, mix buses, bus effects, level meters and adaptive music.

areas.title: Animation
areas.description: Sprite animations and their player, animation assets, Animator keyframe clips, tweens, easing curves, state machines and skeletal animation.

areas.title: Particles and lines
areas.description: Particle emitters on the CPU and the GPU, Line2D and Trail2D.

areas.title: Lighting
areas.description: 2D lights, occluders, shadows and the scene's light map.

areas.title: Shaders and screen effects
areas.description: Shader bundles and materials on nodes, compiling GLSL, and ScreenEffect nodes.

areas.title: UI
areas.description: Labels, menus, UI controls (panels, buttons, progress bars, text fields, scroll boxes, rich text), layouts and themes.

areas.title: Tilemaps and Aseprite
areas.description: Aseprite files, their use in a running game, and TileMap nodes.

areas.title: LDtk
areas.description: LDtk projects as plain data, and LDtkLevel nodes built from them.

areas.title: Dialogue
areas.description: Dialogue files and their runner, Yarn Spinner import, and the DialogueBox node.

areas.title: Navigation
areas.description: Navigation regions and grids, A* paths, and NavAgent nodes.

areas.title: Scripts, globals, data and saves
areas.description: Scripts attached to nodes, global scripts, data resources, saved games, hot reload's snapshots, the name types engine procedures take (scenes, node paths, animations, actions...), and the code uses editors write for each kind of thing.

areas.title: Scene changes
areas.description: Transitions, scenes over scenes, loading screens and menu actions.

areas.title: Project format and loading
areas.description: The project and scene XML format, its parser, and building scenes from parsed data.

areas.title: Assets and import
areas.description: The resource manager, typed asset handles and import settings.

areas.title: Platform, player and web
areas.description: The player program, the platform layer (desktop and browser), the browser player, data packs and static SDL linking.

areas.title: Steam, touch and local multiplayer
areas.description: Steam achievements, stats and cloud files; touch input and on-screen controls; local multiplayer players and split screen.

areas.title: Debug, logging and live
areas.label: Debug and live
areas.description: Debug drawing and the debug overlay, logging (levels, categories, SDL's messages), the live link with the editor, and Spall profiling traces.

areas.title: Utilities
areas.description: Paths, running other programs, and the package overview.
